text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion and I head into our second
summer
camp.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I can do this! Raaagh!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: But of course! After all...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This is the year I shall realize my goal of
trying
every kind of ramen at the beach
house!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Surely you understand that eating
nothing but
ramen is unacceptable from
a nutritional
standpoint.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's why I couldn't complete my ramen

conquest last year. Not only that, we
have a race
in the middle of this summer
camp, correct?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That makes the road to ramen conquest
harsher
yet. However, I have a secret
plan!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I call it... the "Can I have a bite?"
approach! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's one of the many things I've learned
at the
academy! If everyone shares their
food, then I'll
be able to try every
variety on offer!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And that is why I would like to request
your
cooperation. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Certainly! That goes without saying!

Oh...
choice_data_list: Only if you give it your all in training.
Only if you work hard in training.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Looks like you're not wavering anymore.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You're playing your role exactly as
written.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Right. Apologies, but I can't become a
god.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I will, however, perform my role with
aplomb. I'll
run in such a way as to set
your heart dancing.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If I can do that... maybe I can at least
become an
angel.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Are you stupid or something?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Who needs gods or angels? If you won't
do it...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'll just have to take care of it myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, the reason Air Shakur is so
fixated on
Fine Motion remains unclear.
However...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm sure she'll face any obstacle
head-on and
power through.
choice_data_list: Looks like you've steeled your resolve.
Looks like you've steeled your resolve, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I, too, must work hard and become
stronger!
